scope: Partial cumulative source review. Existing files reviewed as diffs against integrated production. New files reviewed in full. This record does not authorize integration.
findings: Existing migration fixtures remove the two newly introduced tables before testing old schemas. Assertions retain key, policy, credential, and rollback checks.
Existing world and broker fixtures explicitly register service domains and provide participant configuration. Production rejection of missing configuration remains covered.
Unique issuer client configuration paths prevent later setup from overwriting an earlier connection configuration.
LeaseBroker releases fixture-owned control leases at teardown. NativeBroker overrides that close method; tests still require unfinished native control to keep the issuer obligation pending.
The broker close path half-closes input and waits for actual process exit. It does not fabricate successful shutdown.
Bootstrap setup creates a fresh proof after idle expiry. It does not replay a mutation. The added idle regression invokes the existing real-file acceptance assertions.
Native denial retries retain the original three-second deadline and require protocol denial. EOF alone never passes. NativeClient closes its socket on extension-discovery failure.
Process tests observe cgroup membership, detached children, independent pidfds, denied cleanup, explicit descriptor inheritance, and sanitized environment.
World and broker tests hold real revocation traffic, pause actual native processes, inspect issuer obligations, and witness input or process cleanup before completion.
Private participant tests use real issuer activation and durable rows. Malformed replies, mismatched identity, wrong parent process, stale replies, frame limits, and expired commands fail closed.
Workspace settlement sends no applied acknowledgement until dispatch, process reconciliation, control cancellation, and native cleanup have settled. Nested consumption invalidates the settled state.
remaining: Complete the other changed-file reviews and all four full qualification profiles. Broker native handoff, world wiring, fencing, and recovery remain separate unfinished work.
